verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents durable execution, long-running workflows, and running agents on a durable background queue. None of these is a recurring schedule or cron-style trigger; they are one-off or long-running execution primitives. Scheduling is a fair axis for an agent framework, but the evidence contains no first-party recurring-job capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
